text: All documents containing internal political information, leadership details, and identifiable government roles must be classified as sensitive. Access to such information is restricted to authorized personnel only, and any sharing outside the approved channels is strictly prohibited.

All employees must ensure that no personal or sensitive contact information—including phone numbers, email addresses, or any personally identifiable information (PII)—is disclosed in any communication or document to prevent unauthorized exposure.
All sensitive information related to Afghan women must be strictly protected and not disclosed without explicit consent to ensure their privacy and safety.
All sensitive information must be handled with strict adherence to quality standards to ensure its confidentiality and prevent unauthorized exposure.

All employees must ensure that no sensitive or personally identifiable information, including personal, family, financial, professional, or government-related details, is disclosed or accessible without proper authorization. Strict safeguards must be applied to protect such information from exposure.

All sensitive government information, including security details, classified documents, official travel plans, internal communications, and operational specifics, must be strictly protected and never disclosed outside authorized channels to prevent exposure and ensure national security.

All strategic business, financial, operational, legal, and diplomatic information must be classified as confidential and protected from unauthorized access or disclosure. Access to such sensitive information is restricted to authorized personnel with a legitimate business need. Sharing or communication of strategic information outside the organization or with unauthorized individuals is strictly prohibited to prevent exposure and maintain corporate confidentiality.

All personal and professional information, including educational background, employment history, organizational affiliations, and mentorship details, must be protected and shall not be disclosed without explicit consent.
